description: This is the main front-end HTML file for a database viewer interface. It defines the structure, styling, and client-side scripting for browsing databases, tables, and viewing table data with interactive features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by re-fetching and updating the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database section, loads its tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders a data array as an HTML table with interactive cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cell content based on the data type.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full or truncated data.

search-terms: client-side HTML script for database visualization
